lines.speaker: mina
lines.text: i pointed at the board and ordered, just like everyone else. liam, you can stop worrying about the fries now :)

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: the spreadsheet line survived with change to spare. cyrus, your list is undefeated

lines.speaker: roxy
lines.text: loaded burger, zero cheese, quiet stomach. best market night yet!!

lines.speaker: cyrus
lines.text: Everyone, stop. Peanut butter on one burger, peanut sauce and crushed peanuts on another, peanuts tossed through the slaw. This is the stall from my notes.

lines.speaker: roxy
lines.text: burgers on the counter, hands up!! nobody hand cyrus anything

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: mine's going back on the tray untouched. cyrus, you lead, we follow

lines.speaker: mina
lines.text: the board is beef, lamb and chicken... and the man says even the fries are cooked in beef dripping. maybe there's a corn cob somewhere nearby?

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: not even FRIES?? fries patrol is officially in crisis. everybody up, we're finding mina a real burger

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: already packing up. liam, maybe the patrol reads the board before it marches in next time

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: one burger here costs the same as three by the fountain?? i said i'd turn around at the gate, and i'm turning around. wallets away, all of you. this is a trip fund emergency

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: she's confiscating our wallets. i'm scared and i respect it

lines.speaker: cyrus
lines.text: For the record, the notes said cheap. Following Maya.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: great burger. two dollar signs though, so i'm sulking the whole bus ride home. as promised

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: i'll sit next to you on the bus. sulking's better with company

lines.speaker: roxy
lines.text: held the cheese like i promised! didn't matter. the bun is a milk bun toasted in butter and the fries come tossed in garlic butter. milkshake incident: the sequel. my stomach is NOT happy

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: our old campus burger spot!! i forgot they put butter in basically everything. that's on the stall, not you, roxy. i'm so sorry
